hull_geometry: Aggressive, bird-of-prey inspired silhouette with down-sloping wings and a forward-set bridge; numerous jagged protrusions and serrated edges
materials_and_finish: Intensely greebled surface with exposed conduits, heat sinks, and structural braces; the hull appears battle-worn and rugged
design_philosophy: Designed to be intimidating, resembling a predatory creature ready to strike from cloaked ambush; brutal efficiency
color_scheme: Dark olive-green and rusted brown metallic finish; engine exhausts and weapon emitters pulse with a menacing green light
distinctive_traits: Asymmetric detailing on a symmetric silhouette gives it a unique, salvaged-but-deadly look
